objective: Preallocate JSON value conversion containers for expression evaluation.

tasks.title: Preallocate JSON conversion containers
tasks.result: JSON array and object literal conversion now preallocates target Value containers from the known serde_json input length.

notes: Cargo/linker verification used an E: workspace temp directory because the default C:/TEMP drive was full.
The conversion preserves recursive JSON value handling, array element order, and object key/value mapping.
